description: This source file defines the GatewayEndpointStore actor in Swift which manages and publishes the state of the gateway control endpoint, including configuration resolution, connection management, and endpoint URL creation. It handles remote tunneling, configuration overrides, and fallback mechanisms, primarily for a macOS application.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: An actor that manages the gateway control endpoint state, configuration, and tunneling for the application.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an async stream of GatewayEndpointState updates, buffering the newest values.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current mode and updates the internal state accordingly.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the connection mode (local, remote, or unconfigured) and updates the endpoint state.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures the remote control tunnel is established and returns its port.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Returns the current GatewayConnection.Config, throwing if not available.

methods.name: cancelRemoteEnsure
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing remote tunnel setup task.

methods.name: kickRemoteEnsureIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates connection to establish remote control tunnel if not already in progress.

methods.name: ensureRemoteConfig
methods.description: Ensures and returns the remote gateway configuration, establishing tunnels if needed.

methods.name: requireRemoteMode
methods.description: Checks if current mode is remote, throwing if not.

methods.name: resolveDirectRemoteURL
methods.description: Determines if a direct remote URL is configured and returns it.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the stream of state updates.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the internal endpoint state and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to fall back to the Tailnet IP address if in local mode.
